multica-ai/multica.description: Make humans and AI agents work as one team — open-source and self-hostable.

letta-ai/letta-code.description: Stateful agents that are like people, with memory, identity, and the ability to learn and adapt

mksglu/context-mode.description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and   enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.

eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain.description: Persistent memory for Claude Code and 6 other CLI agents, stored as plain markdown in your Obsidian vault. Stop re-explaining your projects, decisions and people every session. 45 commands: hybrid sem

vshulcz/deja-vu.description: Memory for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 35 more coding agents, built from the session history already on your disk. Local search, MCP and hooks, no LLM, one Go binary.

Dicklesworthstone/cass_memory_system.description: Procedural memory for AI coding agents: transforms scattered session history into persistent, cross-agent memory so every agent learns from every other

parcadei/Continuous-Claude-v3.description: Context management for Claude Code. Hooks maintain state via ledgers and handoffs. MCP execution without context pollution. Agent orchestration with isolated context windows.

modiqo/waggle.description: Attributed, resolvable artifact references for agent handoffs — a ~30-byte token instead of pasted context. MCP-native; the reference layer for the agent-harness world.

emiliojohann/FocusClaw.description: Agent-native task management for humans and AI agents, built around a local-first API, SQLite storage, projects, calendar views, backups, and plugin-ready integrations.

getzep/graphiti.description: Build Real-Time Knowledge Graphs for AI Agents

GembaCore/gemba-core.description: Agent orchestration dashboard — Kanban UI for any work tracker × any agent runtime.

alamops/agetor.description: The harness orchestrator — a local-first kanban for running Claude Code, Codex, and other CLI coding agents in parallel, each in its own git worktree.

cortexkit/magic-context.description: Unbounded context. Memory that manages itself. One session, for life. The hippocampus for coding agents, part of CortexKit.
